title: A container output is compared by its entries: equal entries in zips of other bytes pass, and an entry missing, unexpected, out of order, of other content or, stored, deflated, and an expected container that is not a zip, are each reported, located at <output>!<entry>
notes: Each example's expected/box.zip and expected/doc.odt is written by internal/vectorgen's TestContainerVectors; the example equal holds the render's entries with every method the render does not fix chosen the other way, and reports nothing.
